leaves.name: real-scheduler-cutoff-with-pending-stop
leaves.replaces: Previously completed native checkpoint and still-pending worker stop replies; no replacement of the pinned AsyncScheduler.schedule, KV allocator, admission controller or Core bypass hooks in the container probe
leaves.implementation: Container probe reuses e3_native37_admission_probe.Stack (same declared reduced constructor config, real production 4048/176/1024 scheduler geometry). It projects the checkpoint/retained-request identity and replaces stop plus _drive_stop only at the absent-worker handshake, with an empty owned reply channel. Its queued request is fresh: erroneous next scheduling reserves a real initial 1024-row frame rather than simulating 101200 tokens of model execution. One actual empty scheduler tick precedes the cutoff, then real Core hooks decide each pending-stop tick. Host four-bridge component separately holds real typed cancel replies across a Core scheduling opportunity and executes the real admission entry.
leaves.equivalence: Exposes the exact None-versus-(None,False) scheduler admission seam. Negative 5c1873a source admits one unexpected frame and dirties real source leases; fixed source admits zero with clean leases. The separate four-bridge test proves certified cancel/FULL ordering without stubbing stop.
leaves.cannot_prove: Full 100-chunk model computation, GPU execution, or native TP/PP transport. CPU-only, no box evidence.
